Read a panel from a file or URL

Source: R/read.R
read_panel.Rd

Reads CSV/TSV, Stata .dta, SPSS .sav or .rds (local path or URL) and declares it a panel with as_panel().

Usage

read_panel(
  path,
  id,
  time,
  time_format = NULL,
  dups = c("error", "keep"),
  source = basename(path),
  ...
)

Arguments

path

File path or URL.

id

Column(s) identifying the individual (a subject, unit, entity, participant, firm or country in other fields). Several columns are combined into one composite key. Unquoted names or strings.

time

The time column (a wave, occasion, visit, period or year in other fields).

time_format

NULL (auto-detect), a strptime() string, or one of "year", "quarter", "month", "week", "index".

dups

What to do when an individual has several rows at the same time: "error" (default) or "keep".

source

Source line for chart footers; defaults to the file name.

...

Passed to the underlying reader.

Value

A tidy_panel.
